description: Daily APY and TVL history of one DeFi pool (a poolId from /defi/yields or a DefiLlama pool URL): up to 365 days with APY base and reward, plus the average, min, max and latest APY over the window. Source: DefiLlama. Use to check whether a yield is steady or a short spike before an agent deposits. Not investment advice. Example: pool=747c1d2a-c668-4682-b9f9-296708a3dd90. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
